records.failureSummary:
Focused AC-numbered unit tests for FR-2 (cell normalization) and FR-3 (column width + padding) via renderTable in src/render.mjs are present in test/render.test.mjs with 10 tests: [FR-2.1] newline->
in header and data cells, [FR-2.1b] CR/CRLF->
, [FR-2.2] pipe escaped as \|, [FR-2.3] leading/trailing whitespace trimmed, [FR-2.4] transformation order on ' a\nb | c ' (newline, then pipe, then trim), [FR-3.1] width = max(3, max normalized length including header), [FR-3.2] short-only column gets width 3, [FR-3.3] wide header or wide data cell drives width, [FR-3.4] every column including the last is right-padded, [FR-3.5] header-only table (empty rows) still yields viable widths. Red-first was demonstrated without touching product code: the real test bodies were executed against the pre-implementation stub (renderTable throws 'renderTable 尚未实现'), reconstructed via a data: URL by substituting only the import specifier in a throwaway copy; result was 10 tests, 0 pass, 10 fail, every one erroring 'renderTable 尚未实现'. With the implementation present the whole suite passes: 11 tests (10 new + 1 existing parse test), 11 pass, 0 fail, 0 errors. npm run build and npm run lint also pass. The task command pnpm test cannot run because pnpm is not installed in the sandbox (sh: 1: pnpm: not found); npm test runs the identical script (node --test) over the same files and passes. No product code (src/render.mjs, src/parse.mjs) was modified by this task; any prior src/render.mjs implementation change belongs to workstream T4, not this QA task.
